advisories.reason: Transitive via fastembed@2.1.0 (tar@^6.2.0 dep) for ONNX model extraction. No tar@6.x backport exists; overriding to tar@7.x breaks fastembed's ESM default-import at runtime (tar@7 is ESM-only, no default export). Tarball fetched over HTTPS from huggingface.co model registry — no attacker-controlled paths. Unblock when fastembed releases a tar@7-compatible build.

Newly-disclosed transitive advisory (not introduced by any code change; main predates the disclosure). grpc-js is pulled in only via the OpenTelemetry OTLP/gRPC trace exporter and is used solely for OUTBOUND span export to the trusted in-tenant OTLP collector — no untrusted party sends gRPC requests to the agent, so the malformed-request server-crash path is unreachable here. Remediate by bumping the OTel SDK to a grpc-js-patched range before expiry.

Newly-disclosed transitive advisory via the OTel OTLP/gRPC exporter (outbound span export to the trusted collector only). A malformed compressed message can crash a client/server, but the agent is the gRPC CLIENT exporting to a trusted collector, not a server receiving untrusted gRPC. Remediate via the OTel SDK grpc-js bump before expiry.

Newly-disclosed transitive advisory via grpc-js/OTel. Schema-derived names can shadow runtime-significant properties; only reached when decoding attacker-controlled protobuf, which the agent never does (protobuf is the trusted OTLP export path). Remediate via the OTel/grpc-js bump before expiry.

Newly-disclosed transitive advisory via grpc-js/OTel. Memory amplification from preserved unknown fields in binary decode; only the trusted OTLP export path decodes protobuf here. Remediate via the OTel/grpc-js bump before expiry.

Newly-disclosed transitive advisory via the OTel SDK. Unbounded memory allocation in W3C Baggage propagation; baggage is set internally by the agent's own instrumentation, not from attacker-controlled inbound headers across the bearer-auth boundary. Remediate via the OTel SDK bump before expiry.

Newly-disclosed transitive advisory. CRLF injection in form-data via unescaped multipart field names/filenames — only exploitable when building a multipart body from attacker-controlled field NAMES. The agent never constructs multipart requests with attacker-controlled field names (research-source fetches are JSON/GET; field names are static). Remediate by bumping the form-data-pulling dep before expiry.

Newly-disclosed tar advisory (PAX size-override parser differential / file smuggling), same dependency path as the existing tar entries above: transitive via fastembed@2.1.0 for ONNX model extraction. Tarballs are fetched over HTTPS from the huggingface.co model registry — no attacker-controlled tar input. Clears when fastembed ships a tar@7-compatible build (see the tar entries expiring 2026-08-22).
